tenants.title: Institutions
tenants.count: {count, plural, =0 {No registered institutions} one {One registered institution} other {# registered institutions}}
tenants.emptyHint: Add the first institution to get started.
tenants.archiveConfirm: Archive “{name}”? All of its users will be blocked from signing in. The data is kept and can be restored later.
tenants.deleteConfirm:
Permanently delete “{name}”?

Everything will be erased for good: users and their accounts, groups, lessons, exams and grades. This cannot be undone.

To pause it temporarily, use “Archive” instead.
tenants.deleteConfirmFinal: Final confirmation: this is an irreversible deletion of “{name}”.
tenants.centerOn: Enable the continuing-education centre for “{name}”? The student split and the centre manager role will appear.
tenants.centerOff: Remove the continuing-education centre from “{name}”? Every student will be treated as the institution's own and no centre managers can be added. No account or data is deleted.
tenants.academicOn: Enable the academic structure (faculties, departments and terms) for “{name}”?
tenants.academicOff: Return “{name}” to the original structure? Faculties and departments will be hidden from users without deleting any data, and come back as they were when re-enabled.
tenants.name: Institution name
tenants.hasCenterLong: Has a continuing-education centre (student split + centre manager)
tenants.addAdminHint: This admin will manage the teachers and students of {name}.
tenants.adminCreated: ✓ Admin “{name}” created — they can now sign in with {email}
tenants.limitsHint: Counts active accounts only. Takes effect immediately: once an institution reaches a limit, no new invitation links, joins, account creations or re-activations for that role are accepted until you raise it. Lowering a limit never disables anyone. Leave empty for no limit.
tenants.limitsInvalid: Enter a whole number of 0 or more, or leave the field empty.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.subtitle: Your account and the platform's settings
settings.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.invitationsHint: The default link validity (in hours) for each invited role, used when the inviter does not set one. The maximum caps every invitation.
settings.aiLimitsHint: The maximum number of AI generation requests per user per hour. Resets automatically every 60 minutes.
settings.lessonLimitRange: The lesson limit must be between 1 and 1000.
settings.examLimitRange: The exam limit must be between 1 and 1000.
settings.examPoliciesHint: Platform-wide defaults for new exams. Teachers can still turn proctoring on for each exam.
settings.proctoringDefaultHint: New exams start with proctoring turned on
settings.violationThresholdHint: The student sees a permanent red warning once their proctoring violations reach this number.
settings.violationRange: The violation threshold must be between 1 and 100.
settings.deletionHint: Controls what happens, across the whole platform, when a teacher or admin deletes a group, lesson, exam or homework.
settings.hardDeleteOn: ON — deleting permanently erases the data (with all submissions and grades). Irreversible.
settings.hardDeleteOff: OFF — deleting moves items to the archive (data kept, recoverable). Recommended.
settings.hardDeleteWarning: Permanent deletion is on. Deleted groups and exams, their students' submissions and grades will be erased for good and will not appear in the archive.
settings.onDevice: On the student's device (no AI cost)
settings.appUrlUnset: not set — falls back to Vercel/localhost
settings.envHint: These values come from the server's environment variables. To change them, edit .env.local (or your Vercel project settings) and redeploy.
